coupling: The name-section parser records an empty module name with sizeof(Name) as its byte length. The later shell name-section helper adds a module-name retrieval path that trusts this length and copies from the payload. The parser edit alone is not exercised by the probe through the original boolean-only helper; the helper edit alone copies the original zero length. Together, an empty name at the end of the name-section payload makes the helper read beyond the allocation.
